title: Unit suite against the release library
body: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c built against the release library without the seams, with real (not NDEBUG) assertions (9 tests): capacity validation, the minimum capacity's full boundary, a NULL payload, FIFO on one thread, wrap-around, NULL and double-free safety, caller-owned storage, the exact size at every alignment, undersized storage refused. Pipeline stage unit-tests-release.
rationale: The shipped code; the three seam tests are compiled out, not skipped.

title: Unit and integration suites under coverage, with the seams
body: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c (12 tests: the allocation failure, the lock-free rejection and the lost claim through the push hook among them) and tests/ITs/integration_tests.c (3 tests) on one instrumented object; gcovr gates lines and branches of app/mpscring.c at 100 %. Pipeline stage unit-tests.
rationale: Every line and every branch, the CAS-retry branch that only contention or the hook reaches among them.
criteria: Every test passes; lines and branches 100 %.

title: Integration suite on the release archive
body: tests/ITs/integration_tests.c against the release archive (3 tests): a simple flow, the storage size round trip, six producer threads against one consumer through a deliberately small ring, each value checked. Pipeline stage integration.
rationale: The many-producer contract through the public API only.

title: AddressSanitizer, UBSan and LeakSanitizer
body: The unit suite (12), the integration suite (3) and a reduced stress (16 producers x 50,000 values) under ASan, UBSan and LSan. Pipeline stage sanitizers.
rationale: Memory errors, undefined behaviour and leaks on every path the suites reach, the caller-owned placement among them.
criteria: Every test passes; no sanitizer report.

title: ThreadSanitizer
body: The integration suite (3, 2,000 values a producer) and a reduced stress (16 producers x 2,000 values) under ThreadSanitizer, never mixed with ASan. Pipeline stage tsan (GCC_BUILD_ENABLE_TSAN=1, set by hand at 1.0.10).
rationale: A data race between the producers, or between a producer and the consumer, is what this ring must never have.
criteria: Every test passes; no race reported.

title: Stress: 16 producers, 8,000,000 values, exactly once
body: tests/stress/stress_mt.c on the release archive: 16 producers push 500,000 encoded values each against one consumer through a ring of 4096; a bitmap indexed by (producer, sequence) aborts on a duplicate, an out-of-range value or a missing one. Pipeline stage stress-run.
rationale: Millions of contended claims at full speed, the roles the ring is for.
criteria: STRESS TEST PASSED; every value seen once.

title: ABI layout and exports
body: utils/check_abi.sh: app/mpscring.h against abi/layout.txt (eight functions and the constant), and the release shared object's exports against utils/mpscring.map (exactly eight functions, version node MPSCRING_1). Pipeline stages abi and abi-exports.
rationale: The interface a consumer links is the one declared.

title: The installed packages
body: utils/smoke_test_package.sh: the debs built, installed into a scratch root, tests/package/smoke.c compiled against the installed header and library alone and run (eight values in, eight out in order). Pipeline stages package and package-smoke.
rationale: The delivery works on its own, not only the source tree.
criteria: The smoke program round-trips its values.

title: Hardening and the glibc ceiling
body: kyr-build's check_hardening on the release artifacts (RELRO, immediate binding, non-executable stack, canaries, fortify, no RPATH, versioned soname, every NEEDED on the allowlist, position-independent archive) and the glibc-ceiling stage. Pipeline stages package and glibc-ceiling.
rationale: The release binary as the platform ships it.

title: Static analysis and the warning gates
body: The audit profile's build (the whole warning set, -Werror and GCC's -fanalyzer) and kyr-build's gates legacy-names, pragmas, tables and warnings. Pipeline stages build:audit, legacy-names, pragmas, tables, warnings.
rationale: Zero warnings under the strictest set; no diagnostic switched off.

title: Inspection of the sequence protocol, the memory ordering and the progress
body: A line-by-line inspection of push, pop, is_empty, storage_size and init_into against ISO/IEC 9899:2011 7.17 and Vyukov's protocol: the slots' initial sequences, the claim only on an equal sequence and a won CAS, the acquire before and the release after each side's access, the next lap's sequence on a pop, the bounded loop of push and the straight-line pop, the window of a stalled producer (SDD 5.3 and 5.4).
rationale: The protocol, the ordering and the limit of progress are properties of the code, which a test can corroborate and never prove.
criteria: Every check of the inspection's list holds; the threaded suites under ThreadSanitizer corroborate it.
